FAQ

Questions, answered

How long does onboarding take?

Most teams are live in under a week. We import your contacts and deals from your current CRM or spreadsheet, map your pipeline stages, and run one working session with each board.

Does Meridian replace our CRM?

For most SMB and mid-market teams, yes — the Lead and Sales boards cover what a lightweight CRM does, plus the KYC and operations workflows a CRM never touches. You can also keep your CRM and sync the two.

How is KYC data handled?

Documents are stored encrypted, access is role-based, and every action — from document receipt to approval — is written to an immutable audit log you can export for regulators.

Can we try it before buying?

Yes. This site is a fully working demo seeded with sample data. Sign in with any email, move cards around, approve a KYC record — nothing here is a slide.

See your business on one screen.

The demo is fully interactive — seeded with a realistic sample company you can move, approve and reset at will.
